ledgerSearch.outcome: CTD-0087 requires that the Four Chapters and the Twelve-Year Trajectory be defined or retired, and CTD-0044 tracks orphan architecture terms. The shipped note that neither supplies milestones or governance is kept, and the baseline content of both figures is restored so a future definition has something to start from.

substitutionCheck: Grepped. They do not yet supply milestones, governance, or evidence that the arc can be delivered and the sentence on later participants revising what founders began are absent from the baseline and are retained.

findings.summary: Both named figures lost their content.

evidence.baseline: The Four Chapters describe the broad movements of the arc, from the awakening of the individual, through the gathering of coherent community, toward the restoration of culture and at last of the biosphere itself. The Twelve-Year Trajectory sets that arc in time: a generational horizon for the maturation of a Body of Worship from a single practitioner into a network of councils.
evidence.shipped: The Four Chapters and Twelve-Year Trajectory name an intended arc from personal practice toward community and ecological repair.

findings.diagnosis: The four movements are the four chapters, and merging them into one clause means the name Four Chapters no longer refers to anything countable. The twelve year figure likewise loses what it measures, which is the maturation of a Body of Worship from one practitioner to a network. CTD-0044 asks whether these are orphan terms. After the pass they are orphan terms.

findings.summary: The distinction between naming a horizon and scheduling it was deleted.

evidence.baseline: To name these is not to schedule them. It is to declare that the work intends endurance, and that the care it offers is not the enthusiasm of a season but the patience of a generation.

findings.diagnosis: This is the volume disclaiming its own timeline, which is exactly what CTD-0087 wants and it is stated better here than in the note that replaced it. The enthusiasm of a season against the patience of a generation is also a real contrast, not an invented one.

evidence.baseline: A community tended this way is built to outlast the people who begin it, which is, in the end, the only kind of community worth building.

findings.authorizedBy: Catalog 4.15, generic uplift, and the only kind under section 5.
findings.diagnosis: Built to outlast the people who begin it is earned by the whole of Part X and is the practical test the section proposes. The only kind is a universal and is reduced. The turn is earned, which is 4.15’s retention limb.

debtImpact.note: Both figures regain their content while the note that neither supplies milestones, governance, or evidence is kept.

The requirement that later participants be able to revise what founders began is kept.

evidence.shipped: Endurance has to be earned through transparent institutions, distributed authority, and the ability of later participants to revise what the founders began.

improvements.note: The baseline wants endurance and never says who may change the design once the founders are gone, which is the exact failure mode Volume III's drift chapter names. The kept clause imports that successors principle into this volume's most institutional section. Promoted from a quiet kept to a credited finding.
